note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the 49-wire topology and the p.87 rule, not printed; p.87 gives no input/output pair. No errata for this page; wires as printed (page prints 5Y/6Y and '2N/DO', read D0). Bit convention: slide switch LEFT = 1 (p.80, O-C12), pushbutton down = 1, switch/pushbutton 6 = 1s bit, 5 = 2s bit, lights 4, 5, 6 = 4s, 2s, 1s (p.72 reading). Topology: all coil F ends on minus, pushbutton arms 5Y/6Y on +. Bit 0 half adder: 6V (= 6C, 6A) is + when switch 6 LEFT with pb6 up (6U-6Z-6Y) or RIGHT with pb6 down (6W-6X-6Y), so relay 6 and light 6 = a0 XOR b0; 6S/6W and 6R/5C put + on 5C only with switch 6 LEFT and pb6 down, so relay 5 = carry c0. Bit 1: 5V (= 4C) gives relay 4 = a1 XOR b1 the same way; 5S/5W and 5R/4A give g1 = a1 AND b1 on node 4A (= 4K, 2C, 3C). Relay 4/5 transfer: 5H(+) reaches 4H (light 5 via 5A, relay 1 via 1C) through 5J-4G when relay 4 in and relay 5 out, or 5G-4J when relay 4 out and relay 5 in (s1 = x1 XOR c0); with both in, 5G-4J/4L-4K carries + to 4A (c1 = g1 OR x1 c0), lighting light 4 and pulling relays 2 and 3. Decoder: minus on arm 6H; relay 6 (s0) selects 1H/1L, relay 1 (s1) selects 2H/3H or 2L/3L, relays 2/3 (c1) select D0-D7 so the minus contact is D(sum). D16/D19 ties the wiper to STOP, D17/M+ and D18/M- run the motor, so the dial runs until the wiper meets the minus contact, which shorts STOP (D18-D19 through the wiper) and stops the motor. Script from the reviewed draft: switches 5, 6 RIGHT, power on (10 s), then switch 6 LEFT, pb6 down, pb6 up, switch 5 LEFT, pb6 down, pb5 down, both up in one tick, switch 6 RIGHT, both down in one tick, 30 s dwell after each (as slow as 25 rpm). Sums 0, 1, 2, 1, 3, 4, 6, 3, 2, 5: every reachable dial value 0-6 and both carry paths (ripple 3 + 1, generate 3 + 3 and 2 + 3). D7 is unreachable. The pad-stop on the target rests on the profile's STOP-short coast (O-R5); indicator lamps are not asserted (relay states stand for them). Digest is a placeholder for the runner.
